title: blob-server memory backend core
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B5. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Implement the memory reference backend core per docs/design/blobext.md §7 (feature memory, knobs under test-helpers): store HashMap<(account, Id), StoredBlob{Bytes | Chunks | Deferred}>, ids B+counter; create_blob storing blobId sources as chunk lists and inline as bytes; clock-injected expires (1 h, 5 min noPersist) and touch_blob (Honoured up to 7 days, Applied beyond); reference index with add_reference_for_test / hide_object_for_test driving destroy_blob (blobHasReference) and blob_references; stored_digest fast path for whole-blob sha-256; advertise_for_test and the default capability (maxDataSources 64, digests [sha-256, sha], supportedTypeNames [], archive/extract [application/x-tar], other lists null, decision 13). Convert and deferred handling come in B6. Acceptance: unit tests for each hook contract in §6; memory module compiles only with the feature.
